attr.title: We are your partner in engineering that works in the real world, focused on results.

attr.content: As your trusted partner, we deliver high-performance forestry solutions to contractors, land managers, and public agencies across the U.S. With decades of engineering expertise and real-world testing, our machines are built to handle extreme conditions, maximize productivity, and deliver consistent results job after job.
Years of engineering experience, with proven expertise in designing forestry and land-clearing equipment.
A customer satisfaction rate that reinforces the trust contractors and agencies place in our consistent field performance.
Higher productivity compared to machines that require frequent maintenance and downtime, reducing overall effectiveness.
Thousands of machines working worldwide delivering productivity across forestry, land clearing and agricultural projects.
